accession_locator: S3.1.p1 ('GSE153100 (human exercise)'); other GSEs are mouse re-analyses
assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), PBMC, NovaSeq 6000 SE150; STAR + TEtranscripts gene and RE counts
sample_inclusion: young sedentary n=5 (2 m), older sedentary n=5 (2 m), older habitually exercising n=4 (1 m) (S3.3.p1)
primary_estimand: Associational: whether long-term habitual aerobic exercise in older adults is associated with attenuation of age-related PBMC gene/RE expression changes; shown as O vs Y and O-EX vs Y DESeq2 MA plots (FIG4A genes, FIG4B RE; S2.p6). Cross-sectional, not a randomized intervention.

exploratory_contrasts.name: OEX_vs_O
exploratory_contrasts.reason: direct exercise-status comparison within older adults; implied by 'changes largely attenuated in exercising older adults' (S2.p6) but no MA plot or count reported

blocking_or_covariance.reason: one sample per subject; groups matched by design (S3.3.p1); no covariates stated

matrix_scale: raw gene + RE counts (STAR + TEtranscripts) (S3.2.p1; GEO data_processing)

reported_counts.O_vs_Y_genes: ~2500 transcripts significantly increased/decreased with aging (FDR<0.1), 'largely reversed with exercise' (FIG4A legend); exact count and up/down not reported
reported_counts.RE: 'numerous' RE increased with aging (FDR<0.1) (FIG4B); counts not reported

other_analyses_not_reproduced: VO2max vs composite RE count correlation (FIG4C)
